caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular pink fabric wrapper with four triangular flaps folded towards the center, meeting at an off-center point. The fabric is a vibrant, deep pink with areas of shading indicating folds and texture. Each of the four corners appears to be secured with a small cluster of white decorative elements resembling pearls or beads. The wrapper is adorned with several white beaded floral and leaf motifs: one near the upper center flap, one on each of the left and right flaps, and a smaller motif at the lower center. Scattered smaller white bead-like dots are distributed across the pink surface. The inner part where the flaps meet reveals a tan-colored area, likely the inside or binding of the wrapper. The background is a plain, off-white or light beige color.
title: Handkerchief Case
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
